title: HB354 (2023 General): Firearm Access Amendments

provenance.fetched_by: Open States bulk data (Utah) (gun-policy Stage 5, Utah); operative text read by a Sonnet fill agent from the official Utah text (Introduced, ; official copy, https://le.utah.gov/~2023/bills/hbillint/HB0354.pdf (Open States text id 90101433))
provenance.note: As-filed (introduced) text; no votes recorded, so it apparently did not pass a chamber.

operative_text:
Section 1 (new Utah Code 76-10-502.5): (2) An owner or authorized user of a firearm shall store or keep the firearm in a secured and locked container or secure the firearm by a locking device that renders the firearm inoperable by any person other than the owner or authorized user.
Section 1 (new Utah Code 76-10-502.5): (3) An owner or authorized user of a firearm may not leave a firearm in an unattended or unlocked vehicle unless the firearm is locked in the trunk, a locked safe, a locked glove compartment, or inaccessible to anyone other than the owner or authorized user.
Section 1 (new Utah Code 76-10-502.5): (4) If a restricted person, a minor, or an at-risk person gains access to a firearm belonging to or under the control of an owner or authorized user, and the owner or authorized user failed to secure the firearm in a locked container or by a locking device, the owner or authorized user in control of the firearm: (a) is subject to a civil fine of $1,000; or (b) if the restricted person, minor, or at-risk person commits a crime or injures another person, is subject to a civil fine of $5,000 in addition to being guilty of an offense one level below the offense charged against the restricted person, minor, or at-risk person.
Section 1 (new Utah Code 76-10-502.5): (5) Subsection (4) does not apply if the firearm is accessed by a person and used in a lawful act of self-defense.
